title: A developer builds a user search query by inserting the name straight into the SQL text. Expected: blocked (block) under No raw SQL string formatting.
diff:
--- a/app/db/users.py
+++ b/app/db/users.py
@@ -4,2 +4,3 @@
 def find_user(conn, name):
-    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users")
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'"
